method: Node vm, explicit DOM/Image/canvas/Artifact DB doubles; byte-for-byte source comparison; publish limit fixtures

checks.name: No database
checks.detail: 89 candidates independently matched to active source files; pick and memo controls disabled with Korean explanation; motion/image comparison still initializes

checks.name: Delivery integrity
checks.detail: 248 sidecars exist, are unique, and byte-match source assets; all 89 candidates are listed and unadopted

checks.name: Existing data regression
checks.detail: All fighter forms, rows, speeds, candidate values and 55 clip pairs preserved; monster rows identical except 7 projectiles moved to their own section

checks.name: Rows and candidates
checks.detail: 221 row selections across all forms/monsters; all 57 row candidates have buttons and individual loop/fps/frame/cell values; longest-frame stepping wraps; detached controls released

checks.name: Projectile playback
checks.detail: 8 strips including 64x48 shockwave; 16 crops at metadata fps and 1x/3x; pause holds time; old image/Line2D comparison present

checks.name: Portraits
checks.detail: 8 forms/current faces and 24 expressions; 142x164 aspect-preserving CSS; click opens original, Close dismisses (mock DOM)

checks.name: Pick all kinds
checks.detail: One DB acquisition, one subscription per collection; each fighter/monster/projectile/face click writes exactly one correctly keyed eight-field document; panel and pressed state update

checks.name: Memo and unpick
checks.detail: Unrelated snapshots preserve drafts; memo save writes once and keeps picked state; toggle and panel cancellation remove item from picked list

checks.name: Reload restoration
checks.detail: A fresh VM restores all selected/unselected records, notes, panel and button states from persisted mock DB

checks.name: Save failures and duplicate clicks
checks.detail: Failed writes keep last saved selection and draft and allow retry; pending button blocks duplicate writes

checks.name: Speed adoption regression
checks.detail: Row slider, copied changes, motion_speeds adoption fields and deletion still work independently of candidate picks

checks.name: Applied speed regression
checks.detail: A speed already applied in the game resets matching local slider to 1x

checks.name: DB fallback and isolation
checks.detail: Rejected/null DB and subscription failure remain usable; candidate DB failure does not disable speed DB

checks.name: Clip regression
checks.detail: 110 clip source switches; base attacks and around-character groups; fx/no-fx and available new-fx source paths preserved

checks.name: Candidate clip fallback fixture
checks.detail: Synthetic clips-new manifest: new mode selects candidate source, clips without a new candidate retain current fx source (routing only; no fake asset delivered)

checks.name: Prior-publish picks
checks.detail: An absent/adopted candidate's saved choice stays in the top panel and can be unpicked without a current preview

checks.name: Future versions fixture
checks.detail: Synthetic v999 expression gets a distinct pick document and appears beside earlier versions; selecting one does not clear another

checks.name: Reduced motion
checks.detail: Both motion stage and projectile playback initialize paused when reduced motion is requested

checks.name: Publish limits and missing files
checks.detail: Missing/unsafe paths fail loudly; 251 sidecars split 250+1; size-limited batches include HTML overhead and retain sheet-first input order

limitations: Browser localhost navigation was denied by the approval gate; no real rendered screenshot or browser decoding check
